claim: One click opens a completed sample inspection without reading or writing real inspection data.
where: landing primary action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; click the landing action; assert completed results, separate demo IndexedDB, reset, and clean exit

claim: Bookmark contents stay on the device; there are no analytics, trackers, remote scripts, fonts, or bookmark-URL requests.
where: landing facts, workbench, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; capture every request through the full demo inspection and download; require same-origin only

claim: The completed demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo; wait for the worker; set the context offline; reload and assert the completed result

claim: The workbench reads HTML, JSON, and CSV exports through 50 MB and reports duplicates, malformed records, and field loss.
sandbox: fresh browser context; inspect all three formats, check the exact byte boundary, and assert every sample finding

claim: The completed inspection downloads neutral JSON, browser HTML, Raindrop CSV, Linkwarden JSON, and a dry-run report.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; download and read every destination file plus neutral and report files

claim: A real completed inspection can be restored after refresh and explicitly cleared.
sandbox: fresh browser context; inspect a real local fixture, reload, restore, clear, and reload again

claim: Neutral archive re-import preserves normalized records, source attribution, and vendor details across repeated round trips.
sandbox: representative JSON fixture with source attribution and a vendor field; export, import, export, and compare full record objects

claim: The complete workbench is free to use without an account or payment.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the free fact and absence of payment, purchase, subscription, or sign-in controls
